newsitem.title: UK: Utd Distillers launches freezer cocktails.
newsitem.headline: Utd Distillers launches freezer cocktails.

text.p: United Distillers, the spirits arm of Guinness Plc, said on Wednesday it had launched a range of freezer cocktails aimed primarily at women.
The unit said it would support the product with a 2.0 million stg marketing campaign that targets consumers, with particular emphasis on women aged 20 to 35.

Tony's Freezer Cocktails will be available in three variants -- Classic Margarita, Mango Daiquiri and Strawberry Daiquiri -- and sold in liquid form to be frozen at home to produce a crushed-ice style cocktail.

With an alcohol by volume level of 5.4 percent, the cocktails will have an introductory price of 1.19 stg per 250 millilitre pack rising to a suggested retail price of 1.49 stg. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
